topic.readerProblem: A founder or marketer wants Google Gemini to name their business when buyers ask, and needs to know what actually influences that and what Google-Extended really does.
topic.connection: AEOeye audits whether Gemini and four other engines recommend a brand; this page explains the Gemini mechanism and how to test it with the same unbranded-question method.

assessment: Rewrites the Gemini ranking guide around what Google documents (Search grounding, Gemini Apps public-information sources, Business Profile, Merchant Center, Google-Extended scope) and separates it from inference. Merges the can-you-do-seo-for-gemini answer. Rests on Google documentation fetched 2026-10-03, one arXiv preprint and AEOeye's crawler study. Deliberately does not claim that Gemini uses the Knowledge Graph (not found in Google's documentation), that Google-Extended is training-only, or that Gemini and AI Mode share identical sources.

sources.supports: Model analyzes prompt, decides whether Google Search can improve the answer and generates queries (Gemini API).
Gemini Apps automatically uses public information from Google Search, Flights, Hotels, Maps, YouTube.
Gemini Apps may provide source links; not all responses include them.
gemini-2.5-flash with Google Search grounding: 63.4% earned / 25.1% brand / 11.5% social for well-known brands vs ChatGPT 93.5% / 6.5%.
SEO best practices remain relevant for generative AI features in Search; list of things you do not need (llms.txt, chunking, etc.); inauthentic mentions not helpful.
Gemini uses public Google Maps information including ratings, websites, opening hours.
Free product listings can appear on Google Search, Maps, Gemini, YouTube and other surfaces; required attributes.
Complete and accurate Business Profile info and reviews/ratings help local results.
Organization structured data helps Google understand and disambiguate an organization; sameAs guidance.
Gemini uses public YouTube information to find videos and understand video content.
Google-Extended scope: Gemini training and grounding in Gemini Apps / Vertex AI; no effect on Search inclusion or ranking.
Search generative AI control covers AI Overviews, AI Mode and Discover generative features and does not affect training.
User-triggered fetchers (incl. Gemini Notebook) generally ignore robots.txt.
AI Mode uses query fan-out across subtopics and shows links.
AI Overviews are an AI snapshot with links in Google Search.
Generative AI performance report covers AI Overviews and AI Mode impressions; page does not mention Gemini.
GA4 default channel group AI Assistant lists Gemini among sources; medium ai-assistant.
Temporary Chats are not used to personalize the Gemini experience.
2025 study of ChatGPT, Claude and Google AI: visibility % reasonable, ranking position unreliable; Gemini app not tested.
More than 1 billion people use the Gemini app every month (Aug 11, 2026).
